It red the dispatch lane at a7c72b55 (job 124798054818, :1241) and passed on re-run. Thirteen rows share the pattern (waitFor on topItems/topParagraphs, then pendingMark null at :1212, :1235, :1268, :1310, :1353, :1383, :1420, :1425, :1477, :1558, :1622, :1637, :1656).
